rules: After restart, ordinary (non-pending, non-durable) requests are not recovered.
No upstream work is performed post-restart.
Projection views (TotalRequestFIFO / ModelFIFO / NodeFIFO) drop the orphaned entries on next snapshot rebuild.
No lease is acquired; no fencing token is issued.
validation_rules: lane MUST be one of: ordinary_dispatch, pending, durable, queue_mirror
